info.name: Surge Platform API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Surge Platform — a multi-tenant SaaS content automation engine. Covers auth, workspaces, RSS ingestion, AI creative pipeline, tone profiles, generated drafts, dispatcher, publishing channels, storage, and queue monitoring.

request.description: Returns health status of all external API credentials (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ideogram, Stripe, MinIO).
Register a new user account. Rate limited to 5 requests per 60 seconds.
Verify email address using the OTP token sent during registration.
Resend OTP verification email. Rate limited to 3 requests per 60 seconds.
Login with email or phone + password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.
Logout the current user and invalidate their session.
Send a password reset OTP to the user's email. Rate limited to 3 requests per 60 seconds.
Reset password using the OTP token received via email.
Retrieve the currently authenticated user's profile details.
Update the currently authenticated user's profile (fullName, phoneNumber, avatarKey).
Create a new company. Requires admin or customer role.
List all companies accessible by the authenticated user.
Retrieve a specific company by ID.
Update a company's details.
Delete a company by ID.
Stripe webhook endpoint for billing events.
Create a new workspace under a company.
List all workspaces accessible by the authenticated user.
Retrieve a specific workspace by ID.
Update workspace name, timezone, or other settings.
Delete a workspace by ID.
Retrieve analytics data for a workspace.
Add a new RSS source to a workspace.
List all RSS sources for a workspace.
Retrieve a specific RSS source by ID.
Update an RSS source's feed URL or description.
Delete an RSS source. Pass force=true for hard delete.
Update workspace queue configuration including fetch frequency and posting times. Automatically reschedules RSS and Autopilot BullMQ jobs.

item.name: Module 5 & 6: Autopilot Scheduler & Generated Drafts
item.description: Generated draft lifecycle management including creation, review, approval/rejection, publishing, and scheduling. Autopilot queue dispatch validates dispatchable drafts, acquires Redis TTL locks, and forwards to DispatcherService.
